description: Validate a report query and run it against live data WITHOUT saving anything, as an Insights report would run it. Returns the total, the rows (the first 100; `rowCount` says how many) and a text `summary`, which for a program, strategy or cycles query also describes the snapshot (milestones, initiatives and the values its view filters take). An invalid query is refused with 400 `invalid_query` and the validator's code in `detail`. Timesheets show only your own time unless you are an Owner. Requires `read` scope and a role that edits reports.

query.description: The ReportQuery: { source, measure, groupBy?, timeRangeDays?, dateField?, filters?, limit?, … }, as described by anyforge_describe_report_catalog.
